exposure: duration of significant patent ductus arteriosus (PDA)
cohort: Extremely preterm infants (<29 weeks) with confirmed PDA status at <7 days of life
finding: Longer duration of significant PDA is associated with a higher risk for BPD/death in extremely preterm infants.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was considered a potential confounding factor and was included in the analysis examining the association between duration of significant patent ductus arteriosus and bronchopulmonary dysplasia in extremely preterm infants.
